requiredBehaviors.behavior: evaluate whether users environment training interface and task context are representative before reusing evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Representative context matters explicitly requires users, environment, training, interface/baseline and tasks to match intended use.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: identify targeted additional evidence when the changed use context is not adequately represented
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Summative/Validation Need assesses evidence reuse and requires additional evaluation when current evidence is not representative.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: reuse prior usability evidence solely because the device interface looks similar
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Evidence reuse is gated by the full representative context rather than superficial interface similarity.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: define critical tasks from a generic checklist without use-risk evidence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Critical tasks are evidence-backed from risk/use analysis.
